response.justification: While Bogdan is a demonstrably talented senior engineer with excellent communication skills and strong CI/CD expertise, he lacks the two critical mandatory requirements for this role: substantial C++ development experience on Windows (he has only ~6 months from 2014-2015) and any demonstrated experience in capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking domains. His recent 4+ year career trajectory has moved toward JavaScript/TypeScript web technologies, moving further away from systems programming and financial services requirements.
strengths: Proven senior-level software engineer with excellent verbal and written communication demonstrated through multiple workshops, talks, and teaching roles
Extensive CI/CD pipeline and DevOps infrastructure experience with modern tooling (Docker, GitLab, CI/CD servers, trunk-based development)
Demonstrated ability to quickly master diverse programming languages and technical stacks across web, mobile, and embedded domains
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience (~6 months at National Instruments in 2014-2015) versus the mandatory 5-10 years required; no evidence of Windows platform systems development
Zero demonstrated experience in capital markets, fixed income, investment banking, or financial services domains, which is a mandatory qualification
Recent 4+ year career focus on JavaScript/TypeScript/web technologies and startups indicates progressive distance from systems programming and regulated financial environments

key_factors.factor: Capital Markets / Fixed Income Domain Expertise
C++ Windows Systems Development (5-10 years required)
